attributes.action: End back-garden fireworks: ban public sale and use, allow licensed displays only
attributes.additional_details:
In November 2026 London had a “very high” pollution alert after fog trapped smoke; the Mayor’s office said Bonfire Night and Diwali fireworks likely contributed.

In a 2023 YouGov poll for Help for Heroes, 23% of veterans said fireworks had triggered a negative experience. The RSPCA estimates 45% of dogs fear fireworks.

Every year, many veterans relive their trauma, pet owners sit up with shaking animals and wildlife flees in terror, for weeks on end. How much longer will we allow this?
attributes.background: Ban the sale of fireworks to the public and their use by anyone outside licensed, organised displays. Random fireworks distress veterans and people with PTSD, terrify animals, and add smoke to our air. Licensed displays would still let communities celebrate Bonfire Night, Diwali and New Year.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
